clubsTeaser.text: Every event needs people who never step on the pitch. Find the crew that fits you.

Pull on
the shirt.
join.text: Recruitment is open for all five clubs. Fill in the form, pick your clubs, and we'll contact you about the interview.

clubsPage.intro: Every tournament needs people who never step on the pitch. Cameras, posters, brackets, stages and ceremonies: our five clubs make matchday happen. Pick the one that fits you.
clubsPage.joinText: Choose a preferred club and a second choice on the form. We'll contact you about the interview.

clubs.name: Media Club
clubs.description: Photos, video and live coverage for every tournament and event the society runs. If it happened on the ground, Media Club captured it.
does: Shoot photos and video on match days
Edit highlight reels and post-match content
Run live stories and coverage on Instagram and Facebook

clubs.name: Graphics Club
clubs.description: The society's visual identity. Graphics Club designs the announcements, fixture posters, results cards, certificates and merch.
does: Design event posters and fixture graphics
Make results cards and match-day visuals

clubs.name: Operations Club
clubs.description: Operations keeps the games running: venues, equipment, schedules, brackets and officials, sorted before the first ball is bowled.
does: Run the ground on match days and coordinate referees

clubs.name: Events Club
clubs.tagline: From Sports Week to Color Day.
clubs.description: Events Club plans the big days: Sports Week, Color Day, opening and closing ceremonies, guests and hosting.

clubs.name: Decor Club
clubs.description: Decor turns a ground into a venue: stage backdrops, banners, prize tables and the full Color Day setup.
does: Design and build stage and backdrops
Dress venues with banners and flags
Set up ceremonies and prize tables

recruitment.closedText: Applications are closed for now. Follow us on Instagram to hear when the next intake opens.
recruitment.lead: Applications are open for all five clubs. It takes about three minutes.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Submit this form with your first and second club choice.

steps.title: We contact you
steps.text: The council reviews applications and messages you with an interview slot.

steps.title: Interview
steps.text: A short chat with the club leads.

steps.title: Welcome to the squad
steps.text: Successful applicants are added to their club.
